scope: Jest Fund D1-D7 reminders through the client HTML5 SDK and approved portal asset
confirmation: Jest list_game_versions returned the exact uploaded version ready and active

behavior.schedule: Seven distinct D1-D7 SDK notifications after registered identity, persisted consent and deletion state are committed
behavior.content: English ASCII bodies at most 100 characters, approved image, bounded CTAs and Daily return payloads
behavior.consent: Guests do not schedule; saved opt-outs cancel owned identifiers; successful account preference saves survive temporary SDK failures
behavior.recovery: Serialized same-tab operations, successful-operation deduplication, bounded partial retries and online/visibility recovery
behavior.refresh: Stable identifiers replace prior schedules on later visits or reconciliation on a new UTC day
behavior.deletion: Existing deletion gate drains in-flight operations and removes every owned current and legacy identifier
behavior.delivery: Jest owns delivery and display; SDK schedule acceptance does not prove delivery

checks.dependencyAudit: Production dependencies: no known vulnerabilities; complete workspace: three moderate advisories, below the configured high-severity release threshold
checks.codeReview: consent rollback issue fixed; no remaining concrete blockers
